company.name: Codat
company.shortDescription: Codat is a financial platform that builds integrated software for small business customers.
company.description:
Codat is the universal API for SaaS and financial service providers. The company provides real-time connectivity to enable software providers and financial institutions to build integrated products for their small business customers. Codat handles the heavy lifting of integrations, leaving providers free to focus on how integrations can improve their products for their small business customers.

Codat is backed by Tiger Global, PayPal Ventures, Index Ventures, and American Express Ventures.

insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Meaningful non-dilutive funding
insights.statement: 3 disclosed grants total $16,487,694, representing 9.33% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $13,381,323 to $825,000,000, a 61.65x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
